label: Task 04 - S3 multipart copy
info:
Server-side S3 to S3 copy using UploadPartCopy.

POST /copy with a JSON body:
{
  "source":      { "bucket": "src",  "key": "path/to/object" },
  "destination": { "bucket": "dst",  "key": "path/to/copy" },
  "partSize":    5242880,
  "concurrency": 4
}

partSize defaults to the S3 maximum of 5 GiB and is raised automatically
when the object would otherwise need more than 10000 parts.

name: validate request
run multipart copy
respond if HTTP
format error
